findings.value: V&A East Storehouse, in Hackney Wick, opened to the public in 2025 and puts the V&A's reserve collection on display.

evidence.quote: the ten o’clock opening to the public of V&A East Storehouse
either by putting it on display
V&A East Storehouse is your access all areas experience of the V&A collection.

notes: The Storehouse is the outer-zone part of the venue; the V&A East Museum in Stratford is not covered here. The OnLondon piece (31 May 2025) is the press source. The V&A's own page is the primary source for what the Storehouse is. No closure or renaming news found. Hackney Wick is in the outer zone, so the editor should keep worth_the_trip.
